title: Fix fumadocs component styling: Import ObjectUI components CSS
body:
## Problem

Component styles missing on fumadocs documentation pages:
- Buttons rendered without background colors (no bg-primary, bg-destructive, etc.)
- Calendar dates and weekday headers collapsed without spacing

## Changes

### Fixed CSS packaging and imports

- **`packages/components/package.json`**: Corrected CSS export path from `./dist/style.css` to `./style.css` → `./dist/index.css` (actual build output)
- **`apps/site/app/layout.tsx`**: Added `import '@object-ui/components/style.css';` after global.css import

The components package builds a standalone CSS bundle (`dist/index.css`) containing all Tailwind utility classes used by components. This CSS must be imported by consuming applications.

### Disabled broken plugin imports

- **`apps/site/app/components/InteractiveDemo.tsx`**: Commented out `@object-ui/plugin-object` import
- **`apps/site/app/components/ObjectUIProvider.tsx`**: Commented out `@object-ui/plugin-object` import

Plugin has missing `@object-ui/data-objectql` dependency causing build failures.
